MAJOR: a backward-incompatible change to the command line (commands, flags, exit codes), the configuration file format, or the state database in a way that needs a manual step from the user; or a change to how document ids are derived.

MINOR: a backward-compatible new feature, such as a new command, flag, configuration key or supported file type.

PATCH: a bug fix, refactor, documentation, test change, or dependency update with no behavior change.
